lane: CONSISTENCY (the chat core, the hubs, THE PLAN, Abilities, the catalogue, the jump bar, the seven looks)

features.name: The chat
features.where: HOME (the first screen), or the talk bar on any screen
say: Remind me at 6 to call the garage
features.does: Talk or type to Ghosty; each step he takes is shown in one plain line, and an answer cut off by a lost signal keeps a RETRY.

features.name: THAT FELT OFF and the thumbs
features.does: Tells him a reply missed, so he can learn from it.

features.name: The Stage and SHOW ME
features.where: in the chat, above the reply
say: Show me that as a chart
Show me a table of it
features.does: Draws a picture, chart or table of the answer next to the words.

features.name: Sources, weighed
features.does: Every claim is labelled (fact, allegation, contested, rumour), and each source says how far it can be trusted.

features.name: Answers with no brain needed
say: What time is it in Tokyo?
features.does: Common asks are answered instantly on the phone, without waiting for the brain.

features.name: The seven rooms (hubs)
features.where: the bar at the bottom: ASK, SEE, MAKE, LEARN, PLAN, LIFE, ME
features.does: Each room shows its screens as instrument cards with two live readings each.
features.note: MAKE folds its seven editors into one EDITORS card with pills.

features.name: THE HOUSE and THE PLAN
features.does: Every room with its screens numbered, the room you're in lit up; one tap opens a screen.

features.name: The jump bar
features.where: the search key on Home (or typing anywhere)
features.does: Finds any screen, panel or ability by a word or a number and opens it.

features.name: Every screen (the deck)
features.does: Every screen with a promise, YOU CAN lines that open the right place, a DID YOU KNOW, and three TRY THIS NOW picks a day.

features.name: Abilities and the everything tab
say: Can you read a number plate?
features.does: Everything Ghosty can do, by scene and by type: each with ways to say it, what it needs, where it lives, since when, and TRY IT.
features.note: Generated from the code, so it can't promise what isn't there; a test checks every link opens.

features.name: Can you…? and WHY
say: Why did you check the roads?
features.does: Answers honestly from the same list, says plainly when a key or link is still needed, and gives the way to it.

features.name: Did you know and offers in context
say: Tell me something you can do
features.does: Suggests an ability that fits where you are and what you're doing.

features.name: WHAT'S NEW
features.where: MAKE → Workshop (top), once per new version
features.does: Lists this week's changes in plain words, with the earlier ones behind a key.
features.note: Kept by hand: it needs a line added for every change.

features.name: The seven looks
features.does: Seven whole looks (The Scan, The Map, The Eye, Orbit, One Ink, Grown Up, Glass) and twelve colours.

features.name: THE LOOK
features.does: The presets, the grounds and the switches, each with its contrast measured.
features.note: Two things are both called 'the look': the THEME picker and this screen.

features.name: Colours by plain name
features.does: Plain colour words reach the right theme.

features.name: The orb (his mind)
features.does: Listening, thinking, speaking, low and off are each told apart by its light.

features.name: The Me sheet and the status dials
features.does: A status card with three dials, and Memory, Settings, Links, System and Every screen one tap away.

features.name: Voice: talk, barge in, speak first
features.where: the talk bar; Settings → VOICE & HOME
features.does: Talk hands-free and interrupt him; set how chatty he is unprompted.

features.name: Names that mean one thing
features.does: Each screen should have one name.
features.note: Still named two or more ways: Courses vs Learn; People (the screen, the Lens mode and the introduced voices); Me (the room, the sheet and the Memory pill); the Game Studio (four names).

upward.why: Every screen is called the same thing in the bar, the deck, the jump bar, the catalogue and his speech, so 'open X' never misses.
upward.builds_on: The consistency check (it already catches two screens sharing a name)

upward.why: Never stale again: each landing adds its line from its own change note, in his words.
upward.builds_on: WHAT'S NEW, and the commit notes every lane already writes

upward.idea: TRY IT that proves it worked
upward.why: After TRY IT, Ghosty shows a tick only once the thing actually did its job (the panel opened, the answer came), so Abilities is a live health check.
upward.builds_on: Abilities' TRY IT and the abilities health marks

upward.idea: A guided tour of the house
upward.why: A two-minute walk through the seven rooms, with one 'do this now' in each, for himself or someone he shows Ghosty to.
upward.builds_on: THE PLAN, the deck's TRY THIS NOW

upward.why: 'where do I paste a bank statement' opens Money straight away, using the same meanings table the chat uses.
upward.builds_on: The jump bar and the meanings table (play music → radio)

upward.idea: Abilities sorted by what he really uses
upward.why: The things he uses most come first, and the never-tried ones are offered gently, kept on the phone only.
upward.builds_on: The everything tab, and the phone's own recent and favourite lists

upward.why: After a new version, a one-tap card shows only the changes to screens he actually uses.
upward.builds_on: WHAT'S NEW and the phone's recent screens

upward.why: Paper by day, Black at night, Glass at work, all automatic and by his own rules.
upward.builds_on: The 'ground follows the day' switch and his saved places

upward.idea: Every claim with its proof one tap away
upward.why: Every line Ghosty says about himself (in Abilities or 'can you') links to the screen that does it, or says honestly 'not yet'.
upward.builds_on: The catalogue's WHAT IT NEEDS and the consistency check

upward.why: System shows 'no errors on any screen this week', checked on the phone in the background; an error found is shown in his words with RETRY.
upward.builds_on: The error voice and the consistency check's sweep

upward.why: Every screen gets its picture, its best trick and its numbers today (e.g. Water 1.2 l), so browsing Every screen is a pleasure.
upward.builds_on: The deck cards and the hub cards' live readings

upward.why: Pin, reorder or hide cards in a room, and keep that on the phone.

sideways.why: 'How do I…?' gets the exact taps and a TRY IT, answered from the catalogue with no brain needed.
sideways.builds_on: The catalogue's ways to say it and where it lives

sideways.why: 'Morning' runs Brief, then water, then the roads: one word for a chain of things.
sideways.builds_on: The deck's YOU CAN actions and the command list

sideways.idea: A home-screen widget per hub card
sideways.why: The same two live readings on the phone's own home screen.
sideways.builds_on: The hub cards' readings and the installable page

sideways.why: One switch for largest text, calm motion, high contrast and spoken labels on every key.
sideways.builds_on: THE LOOK's switches and the 44-point rule

sideways.idea: Print or share 'what Ghosty can do'
sideways.why: A clean one-page PDF of all his abilities to show a friend, made on the phone.
sideways.builds_on: The everything tab and the documents editor

sideways.why: Things he has asked for that Ghosty can't do yet, kept and shown, so nothing he wants is forgotten.
sideways.builds_on: Can you…? answers that say 'not yet'

sideways.why: Moving through rooms and cards with a game controller or keyboard, on a tablet or TV.
sideways.builds_on: THE WALL and the Arcade's controller support

sideways.why: Send his exact look (world, colour, switches) as a short code to his other devices.
sideways.builds_on: The look recipe already saved on the phone

sideways.why: THE PLAN and Abilities work with no signal at all, with what needs a signal greyed and said.
sideways.builds_on: Abilities kept on the phone, and the offline brain

sideways.why: One untried ability a day in the Brief, with TRY IT.
sideways.builds_on: Did you know, and the catalogue's 'since' dates

cross.why: 'Show me around' walks the house by voice, and each room answers to the many ways he names it.
After the Lens names something, it offers the next useful ability (translate, save the receipt to Money, add it to the shopping list).
THE PLAN shows a small lock on rooms that hold private data, and says what stays on the phone.
'What did I do in Ghosty last week?' answers from his own screen history, kept on the phone.

cross.idea: The boot film ends on his day
cross.why: The seven-second film lands on the room he uses most at that hour.
The Brief borrows each room's two live readings (water, money due, the next timer), so the day reads as one page.
